contract.registration_activation: A successfully registered callback becomes active for event delivery
contract.unregistration_cleanup: Successful unregistration removes the callback from the listener registry
contract.registry_empty_state: The listener registry becomes empty after removing its final callback
contract.reactivation: A previously removed callback can be registered again and becomes active for subsequent emits
contract.reactivation_idempotency: Reactivation creates exactly one listener entry
contract.reactivation_delivery: A reactivated callback receives subsequent events normally
contract.final_cleanup: The reactivated callback can subsequently be removed successfully
contract.registry_stability: Registration, removal and reactivation preserve listener registry integrity
contract.emit_success: EventBus.emit() remains successful throughout the registration lifecycle
contract.permission_enforcement: EventBus callback operations require the events permission
